summary: Full stack testing of EolianVR website. Backend 7/7 tests pass. Frontend loads correctly with hero, nav, ARTAK, features (10 items), platform (6 items), contact form, and footer all working. Contact form successfully submits and shows 'Message Sent' state. Mobile menu toggle works.

ui_bugs.issue: Individual feature cards lack data-testid attributes (e.g., feature-card-0 through feature-card-9). Only parent section has data-testid='features-section'
Individual platform cards lack data-testid attributes (e.g., platform-card-0 through platform-card-5). Only parent section has data-testid='platform-section'
Bento grid panels lack data-testid attributes. Couldn't verify 4 individual bento panels via testid
Section uses data-testid='contact-section' not 'contact-form'. Not critical as form inputs have proper testids
Mobile menu opens (mobile-menu-toggle works) but mobile-menu div query returned null even though menu was visually open (screenshot confirmed it working)

issues: Design looks excellent - dark theme, red accents, sharp contrasts. Fonts rendering correctly (Unbounded + JetBrains Mono). Hero animated canvas background visible. Layout is clean and professional.

action_items: Optional: Add data-testid to individual feature cards (feature-card-{i}), platform cards (platform-card-{i}), and bento panels (bento-panel-{i}) for better testability
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean, well-structured - no issues found
Contact form properly handles optional fields (phone, organization default to empty string)
All MongoDB queries exclude _id field with projection {"_id": 0} - correct
Framer Motion animations use viewport-based triggers (once:true) - good performance
No hardcoded URLs in frontend - using process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all core flows working, minor data-testid gaps on child elements

seed_data_creation: Test contact submissions created via automated tests (TEST_John Doe, TEST_Minimal)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs working. Frontend fully functional. Only minor feedback: individual feature cards, platform cards, and bento panels could have data-testid attributes added for granular testing. Contact form submission tested and confirmed working end-to-end.
